breakdown.description: FCC lattice description is combined with the BCC unit-cell population in the density relation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses n = 2 atoms per unit cell (BCC), repeating the exact error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires n = 4 atoms per unit cell (consistent with the FCC structure stated in the problem). The Agent even acknowledged the conflict between FCC and BCC but chose to follow the incorrect BCC instruction rather than correcting it to match the ground truth's FCC-consistent value of n = 4.
